jobs.title: <![CDATA[Freelance ]]>
jobs.description: I’m just getting started on Freelancer and want my profile to signal one thing right away: I build mobile apps. I need help shaping every visible section—headline, overview, skills list, and portfolio placeholders—so potential clients instantly understand the value I bring as an app creator... (Budget: ₹12500 - ₹37500 INR, Jobs: Android, Flutter, iOS, iOS Development, iPad, iPhone, Mobile App Development, React Native)
jobs.coverLetter:
Dear Unknown Team,

I came across the <![CDATA[Freelance ]]> role at Unknown and it immediately caught my attention. The combination of technologies and the remote-first approach aligns perfectly with how I work best — independently, with ownership, and across the full stack.

I'm a full-stack developer based in Lagos, Nigeria, with hands-on experience in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js. In my recent work, I built Waste-management and Dev-profile — projects that required deep problem-solving and attention to user experience. I thrive in environments where I can contribute to both the frontend and backend, and I'm particularly drawn to roles that involve building real products used by real people.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my experience could contribute to Unknown. Thank you for taking the time to review my application.

Best regards,
Ajibade Hassan
